Source identity and reproducibility do not establish trust in a toolchain.
Hosted profile A, C17. GCC floating options and Clang FENV_ACCESS plus actual runtime observations; no claim all compilers implement the full pragma contract.
MPFR/GMP are host-side independent oracle dependencies, never target runtime or first-principles sum implementations. Rational model does not inherit nominal long-double precision.
Four actual rounding modes, process-local SSE FTZ with restoration, narrow -mlong-double-64 arithmetic probe, actual x87 and contracted/noncontracted objects; no physical target measurements.

Strict and fast kernels linked to strict caller; timings only on admitted exact finite dyadic workload. Exceptional controls violate the relaxed compiler contract: local observations, not portable C goldens. Clang negative translation is separate from semantic mutants.
Prior fixed-point reference provider is imported unchanged; no future T17/T12 learner component is required.
Restore failure is reported without publishing results, but a failing platform restore cannot guarantee unchanged environment.
External review, independent learner, seven-day transfer and physical evidence remain absent. Finite checks do not prove absolute mastery.
